reviews.title: Coin bug
reviews.text: I’ve always loved this game for years now. I love playing it, but there’s been such a huge problem with my coins just disappearing. I opened to app just now to 147 coins, and I went to buy a new pack. It immediately brought me to the store, so I restarted the app. My coins went immediately to 22 coins. This has happened over 10 times already, the first time being over 800 coins to just 3 coins out of nowhere :( please fix this bug!! I don’t want to delete the app but it’s getting close because it’s to the point that I can’t get any money to buy new packs, so I’m just stuck in the same spot
